title: Coefficientwise chain rule for linear images under Möbius substitution
statement: Let n∈ℕ and V=BinaryForm ℂ n. Let A:V→V be complex linear, F:ℍ→V, P∈V, σ∈SL₂(ℤ), and τ∈ℍ. Suppose that for every exponent index d:Fin 2→₀ℕ, the function z↦coeff d(F(ofComplex z)) has complex derivative coeff d(P) at the complex coordinate of στ. Then, for every exponent index e, the function z↦coeff e(A(F(σ·ofComplex z))) has complex derivative coeff e(A(P))/jFactor(σ,τ)² at the complex coordinate of τ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (F : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (P : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (τ : UpperHalfPlane), (∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.coeff d (F (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)).val) (MvPolynomial.coeff d P.val) ((σ • τ : UpperHalfPlane) : ℂ)) → ∀ e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.coeff e (A (F (σ • UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z))).val) (MvPolynomial.coeff e (A P).val / (HeckeEis.jFactor σ τ) ^ 2) (τ : ℂ)
